note: Build 14 plus one piece, reviewed twice by someone who did not build it and verified together (R632-R640), and one test mend. Nothing is asked after a stop (FR-765, FR-764): when a run of Find and acquire is stopped - by a stop, a project's lock, a library move or a close - its lookups in the air end at once: no retry, no redirect hop, no new request; a stopped Zotero sync ends its wait and asks nothing more; other projects' lookups on the same client are not disturbed. No sensitive answer is kept after a lock (FR-759, FR-767): an answer about an encrypted project's source that arrives after the project was locked no longer stays in the app's memory - closed for attaching a file, bulk import, watched folders, the Zotero import with its resume, and Zotero sync. FR-763: a test that compared a fixed date with today's date, and would have begun to fail on 11 December 2026, passes its own time. Nothing on any screen changes.
